style: シェルは本文の女性、荷担ぎは本文の男性として描く。師の女性としての描画、三人の年齢感・髪・衣装・容貌は美術設定。師と荷担ぎの氏名・他依頼との同一性・新しい経歴は追加しない。縄・標本・報告書を人物画へ固定しない。

files.prompt_en:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: transparent full-body character portrait for a Japanese fantasy adventure game
Primary request: Sher, a woman archaeologist accompanying an expedition into a sandy corridor to find her missing mentor. A composed, alert expression and a slight thoughtful tilt of the head. Standing upright with empty hands loosely held near her waist.
Subject: an adult woman with warm brown eyes, dark brown hair gathered in a compact low bun with a few loose strands, medium warm skin, a muted ochre fitted field coat over an ivory linen shirt, deep teal practical trousers, a plain dark leather belt, and sturdy brown ankle boots. A narrow readable silhouette with restrained detail.
Style/medium: fine ink outlines, soft layered watercolor and opaque painted shading, restrained storybook fantasy illustration, nuanced fabric folds and natural warm skin tones.
Scene/backdrop: completely transparent background, isolated single figure with actual alpha.
Composition/framing: vertical 1024 by 1536 canvas, entire standing figure and both hands visible, generous transparent margin above the head and beneath both boots, the figure occupies about 80 percent of canvas height and stays within the central 55 percent of the width. Three-quarter front view, clearly readable face, neutral soft even light.
Constraints: exactly one person. Empty hands. No sand, floor, background, other people, ropes, specimens, bags, tools, papers, books, writing, emblem or watermark. The hair, age, face and clothing are art direction only; do not add history or additional lore.
files.prompt_ja: 日本語ファンタジーADV用の透過全身人物画。砂の回廊へ入り、行方不明の師を探す探索隊に同行する考古学者シェル。落ち着きと注意深さのある表情で、少し考えるように首を傾け、空いた両手を腰の近くでゆるく寄せて立つ。温かな茶色の目、暗い茶髪を小さな低いお団子にまとめ、少し後れ毛がある成人女性。温かな中間色の肌。くすんだ黄土色の身体に沿う調査用上着、生成りの麻のシャツ、深い青緑色の実用的なズボン、無地の暗い革ベルト、丈夫な茶色の足首丈の靴。細身で読み取りやすい輪郭と抑えた細部。細いインク線、水彩の重なりと不透明な塗りによる柔らかな陰影、抑制した物語画、細やかな布のしわ。背景は完全透過。1024×1536の縦長画面に全身と両手を収め、頭上と両足の下に十分な透過余白を置く。人物は高さの約80％、幅の中央55％以内。斜め前向き、読み取りやすい顔、柔らかく均等な光。人物は一人、手は空にする。砂・床・背景・他の人物・縄・標本・袋・道具・紙・本・文字・紋章・透かしは入れない。髪・年齢感・顔・衣装は美術設定で、経歴や新たな世界設定を加えない。
